tooltip.planned_command: Planned: opens the reference help for %s
about.blurb: A free NURBS, SubD and mesh modeler with Rhino 8's command vocabulary. Totally free: no subscription, no payment, no licence keys, no accounts, no telemetry.
about.kernel: Geometry kernel: OpenNURBS (McNeel, MIT licence) + Manifold (Apache 2.0)
about.file_format: Native file format: .3dm (reads and writes Rhino 8 files)
about.keyboard: Keyboard: F1 command list, F2 history, F3 properties, F7 grid, F8 ortho, F9 grid snap, F10 control points, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo, Esc cancel.
options.title: Options
options.general_intro: Dino 8 has no licence, update-check or account settings: there is nothing to configure here that could ever lock you out.
options.theme_high_contrast_hint: High Contrast: WCAG-AA-ish text/background contrast, and hover/selected/disabled states shown with outlines, not just colour.
options.show_welcome: Show the welcome card on empty documents
statusbar.tip.current_layer: Current layer: new objects go here. Click to change.
statusbar.tip.grid_snap: Snap picked points to the grid (F9)
statusbar.tip.planar: Keep picks at the elevation of the previous point
statusbar.tip.gumball: Drag selected objects with the on-screen gumball
cmddesc.polyline: Draw a multi-segment polyline with options for line and arc segments, tracking line helpers, and close.
cmddesc.circle: Draw a circle from center and radius, diameter, points on the circumference, and circumference length.
cmddesc.arc: Draw an arc with options for center, start, angle, and direction.
cmddesc.ellipse: Draw a closed elliptical curve from focus points, center and edges, bounding rectangle, and around a curve.
cmddesc.rectangle: Draw a rectangular closed polyline with options for starting at the center, three points, vertical, and rounded with arc or conic corners.
cmddesc.curve: Draw a curve from control point locations.
cmddesc.interpcrv: Fit a curve through picked locations.
cmddesc.move: Move objects from one location to another.
cmddesc.rotate: Rotate objects around an axis perpendicular to the construction plane.
cmddesc.scale: Change the size of objects uniformly in the x, y, and z directions.
cmddesc.mirror: Create a mirror-image copy of objects.
cmddesc.array: Copy and space objects in columns, rows, and levels.
cmddesc.arraylinear: Copy and space objects in a single direction.
cmddesc.arraypolar: Copy and space objects around a central location.
cmddesc.orient: Transform objects using two reference and two target points.
cmddesc.trim: Cut and delete selected portions of an object at the intersection with another object.
cmddesc.join: Connect curves, surface edges, or surfaces to form a single object.
cmddesc.fillet: Add an arc between two curves and trims or extends the curves to the arc.
cmddesc.filletedge: Create a tangent surface between polysurface edges.
cmddesc.chamfer: Create a line segment between two curves and trims or extends the curves to meet it.
cmddesc.chamferedge: Create a ruled surface at polysurface edges.
cmddesc.offset: Copy a curve parallel to the original.
cmddesc.offsetsrf: Copy a surface parallel to the original.
cmddesc.extrudecrv: Drive closed planar curves in a straight line.
cmddesc.extrudesrf: Drive surface edges in a straight line to create a solid.
cmddesc.booleanunion: Combine the volumes of one or more objects.
cmddesc.booleandifference: Subtract the volume of one set of objects from another.
cmddesc.booleanintersection: Create a new solid from solids' intersected volumes.
cmddesc.cap: Fills planar holes in objects with planar faces.
cmddesc.loft: Fit a surface through profile curves that define the surface shape.
cmddesc.sweep1: Fit a surface through profile curves and one edge curve.
cmddesc.sweep2: Fit a surface through profile curves and two edge curves.
cmddesc.revolve: Create a surface or SubD by revolving a profile curve around an axis.
cmddesc.networksrf: Fit a surface through a network of crossing curves.
cmddesc.lock: Lock objects so they cannot be selected for editing.
cmddesc.saveas: Save the current model with a different name, close the current model, and open the new model.
cmddesc.import: Merges objects from another model file.
cmddesc.export: Save selected objects to a new file.
cmddesc.new: Create a new model based on a template.
cmddesc.zoom: Move the viewport camera so the area defined by a window selection fills the viewport.
cmddesc.pan: Shift the location of the view camera and target parallel to the view plane.
cmddesc.setview: Change the view to a standard construction plane view.
cmddesc.distance: Report the distance between two picked locations.
cmddesc.volume: Reports the volume of the supported object types.
cmddesc.length: Report the length of curves or surface edges.
cmddesc.dim: Draw horizontal or vertical linear dimensions.
cmddesc.leader: Draw an annotation leader with attached text.
cmddesc.hatch: Fills a pattern of lines within the selected bounding curves.
cmddesc.group: Organize objects into a single component.
cmddesc.ungroup: Remove the group status from objects.
cmddesc.insert: Insert block objects stored in the file or import a file as a block definition.
